AnyCVT.Description: Belt CVTs for small, medium and large engines. Each looks like the stock gearbox of its size and bolts on the same way. Shift R, N and D from a lever; in D the ratio slides to hold the engine at a target RPM, and a centrifugal clutch lets it idle while stopped. Low and high ratio, target RPM, response and engage RPM in Properties; ratio, engine_rpm, target_rpm and current_gear outputs. Found in loot from the first bunker on. Standalone mod, not part of a bundle. Anymaker 0.1.28 only.
